title: Agent manifest (agent.json), spec version 1
description: The optional manifest that sits next to agent.md in .agents/agents/<name>/. The prompt, name and description live in agent.md; this file declares scope, identity, memory, limits and requests. See SPEC.md. Unknown root fields are allowed here because readers must warn about them, not reject them (SPEC § 9.2).

$schema.description: Informative. Lets editors validate the file. Readers never decide anything from it. Point it to a version tag, not to a branch.

specVersion.description: Major version of the spec this manifest follows. A reader that does not support it does not load the agent.

id.description: Stable identifier of the agent, independent of its name. Generated once by the tool that creates the agent; never edited, never reused. Keys the agent's memory across renames.

scope.description: repository: used only inside this repository. shared: exported when this repository is used as a source by another project.

version.description: Descriptive Semantic Versioning 2.0.0 version, shown to people. Readers never decide anything from it: what ran is identified by commit and digest.

skills.description: Repository-relative paths to skill folders outside the agent's own skills/ folder that this agent uses. The agent's own skills are declared by placement and are not listed.

extensions.description: Tool-specific blocks, one per tool namespace. Opaque to the standard except for each block's own version.

name.description: Not part of the manifest. agent.md is the only source of the name; readers warn when it is repeated here and fail when it differs.

description.description: Not part of the manifest. agent.md is the only source of the description.

slot.description: A name the environment binds to a concrete provider. Never a path, URL or command.

why.description: Why the agent needs it. Shown to the person who approves the request.

memory.description: Where what the agent learns lives. Defaults: reach project, store local.

reach.description: project: one memory per project. agent: one memory per agent across the projects of one environment (workspace), never across environments.

store.description: local: the reading tool's own storage. { slot }: an external store the environment binds; a widening request.

permissions.description: Narrowing fields. Intersected with what the launcher has; they can never grant anything.

ceiling.description: The most permissive mode the agent may run in. read-only: no edits and no command execution. ask: each edit or execution needs approval. auto: no ceiling beyond the launcher's.

tools.description: Allow-list of tool classes. Unknown classes grant nothing.

requires.description: Widening requests. Never granted from the repository: the person approves them, bound to the source and the digest.
